sources.finding: Intermediate next-character supervision helped optimize deep untied character transformers. Intermediate-layer weights decay away during training in that paper.
sources.our_difference: Our proposed fixed half-weight shared-head exits are a separate optimization hypothesis. No extra classifier, adjacent-future target or selected-position weighting is added. This is not a reproduction or evidence of useful thought content.

sources.finding: PonderLM adds a probability-weighted embedding to the input and repeats the language-model forward pass, with differentiable self-supervision. It reports parameter/data and compute comparisons under its own training schedules.
sources.our_difference: Our 200M-target,79.18M-parameter screen tests early learning in a different body/data regime. Its negatives cannot establish that the published method or all small latent models fail. This does not automatically authorize longer training.

sources.finding: PonderLM-3 trains adaptive token-wise latent computation with differentiable masks; its principal Pareto comparison is prediction versus inference FLOPs.
sources.our_difference: Keep inference,training-work and learning-mechanism claims separate. The current fixed joint-exit test has no learned allocation.

decision: Finish qualification, then at most a separately registered objective comparison. No scientific claim from literature analogy.
